mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapter (story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, target_characters, actual_character_count, memory_extraction_status, status) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{stageId}, #{planId}, #{chapterNumber}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{generationStatus}, #{targetCharacters}, #{actualCharacterCount}, #{memoryExtractionStatus}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'DRAFT'))
mapper.sql: id, story_id, stage_id, plan_id, chapter_number, title, content, summary, generation_status, target_characters, actual_character_count, memory_extraction_status, current_revision_id, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM chapter WHERE stage_id = #{stageId} ORDER BY chapter_number ASC, id ASC
SELECT FROM chapter WHERE story_id = #{storyId} ORDER BY chapter_number ASC, id ASC
